verdict.rationale: Postman exposes a well-documented public REST API (postman-docs-5, verified live via openapi.json probe), a CLI verified to run headlessly (probe-6), and dedicated AI-agent integration points including an official remote MCP server (probe-4, probe-7 handshake) and CLI context for coding agents (postman-docs-3). These give AI-native users multiple documented, functioning programmatic access paths.
